changes: Pearls restored to 75% of original radius: 50% larger than the previous bake. Gemstones unchanged. Animated assets version with the app.
Visible mtgish rejection message, Details context, and conditional custom short-name repair hint. Upstream parser unchanged.
Local illustration contour derivation for exported Etched/Opal foil; owned mask URLs released. Previously a fabricated printing ID suppressed these contours.
Six-second video: quick flash, rolling/depth orbit, 2.2-second centered hold. All four corners travel; overlapping mesh clips remove dark antialias seams.
Neris Prismatic, Crownroot Opal, Observatory Cold foil; existing saved copies keep their treatments.
Consumer-owned idle preview pose updates foil lighting without face replacement. Motion stops during interaction, reduced motion, busy/hidden/offscreen states or carousel pause.
Direct finish choices behind a sparkle button beside the card; keyboard, touch and persistent selection.
One previous successful artwork plus prompt, artist and generation settings in IndexedDB. Restore survives reload. Failed/cancelled regeneration retains current art and prompt.
Jewel switches to its still image during generation/loading/export, then resumes according to visibility and reduced motion.
